channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Yemeni government forces claim 1,860 Houthis ‘neutralised’
item.description: Yemeni government forces said in a social media post that they carried out 2,103 'precise targeting operations'.

item.title: US stocks slide as oil prices fluctuate over renewed Iran war fears
item.description: Oil prices rose on fresh concerns about Middle East supplies, before falling on the possible release of more reserves.

item.title: Saudi Arabia confirms three dead in Houthi strikes on its airports
item.description: Saudi Arabia has confirmed that Houthi strikes on two of its international airports have killed three people.

item.title: Yemen war live: Yemeni forces claim key heights as Houthi attacks go on
item.description: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces claim advances in western Taiz's mountain belt overlooking the coast.

item.title: UN peacekeeping force in Lebanon says shots fired at Israeli border post
item.description: The United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon said there were no casualties after small arms fire targeted a border post.

item.title: Israelis mourn 7 October attack victims three years after deadly Hamas raid
item.description: Memorial events have taken place in Israel on the third anniversary of the Hamas-led attack that sparked the devastating Gaza war.

item.title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to take any personal responsibility for what happened or order a state inquiry.

item.title: Children killed while they slept as Russian missile kills 19 in block of flats
item.description: Five children are among the victims of a strike that destroyed 30 flats in northern Ukraine as families slept.
